subject: SeedSpark cohort access pass verification & self-serve claim
messages:
From: Anna Brooks <anna@seedspark.vc>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SeedSpark cohort credit allocation (Founders Batch 9)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for making the credits program available — I'm Anna, partnerships at SeedSpark Ventures. We're onboarding our Founders Batch 9 (10 companies) and would like to request startup credits for three portfolio companies that will be running inference-heavy demos during demo week. The companies are early-stage (pre-Series A) and enrolled in our incubator.

Attached: SeedSpark_Incubator_Letter.pdf (PDF) — official cohort confirmation; cap_table_snapshot.csv (CSV) — high-level cap table for the three nominees.

Can Redwood confirm eligibility and whether we can issue self-serve credit claims for each company? Target start date for credits: Nov 15. If you need any other verification (incubation agreement or contact for our ops team), I can provide it today.

Appreciate a quick turn here — our timeline is tight.

Best,
Anna Brooks
Partnerships, SeedSpark Ventures
anna@seedspark.vc

Attachment stubs: SeedSpark_Incubator_Letter.pdf (PDF), cap_table_snapshot.csv (CSV)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Brooks <anna@seedspark.vc>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SeedSpark cohort credit allocation (Founders Batch 9)

Hi Anna — thanks, and welcome. I've looped in Vivek from Partnerships Ops so we can move quickly.

Quick checklist so we can approve self-serve claims and issue activation links:
- Confirm the three company legal names and primary admin emails (we need these to generate claim tokens).
- Incubator letter (you included — thanks) is sufficient evidence of enrollment. If any company is still pre-incubation, we may need their accelerator acceptance email.
- Cap table snapshot is fine as an initial check; we only need a one-line confirmation that none of the companies is a public company.

Timing: If you can reply with the admin emails and confirmation by EOD Nov 4, we can provision provisional credits and send self-serve claim links (claim links expire in 21 days).

I'll coordinate the final issuance with Product Ops (cc'd) and Billing (I will loop them in once approved).

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Startup Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Brooks <anna@seedspark.vc>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: apply@seedspark.vc
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SeedSpark cohort credit allocation (Founders Batch 9)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note. Confirming the three startups and primary admin emails below:

1) BrightLayer Inc. — ceo@brightlayer.ai
2) HushHealth Ltd — hello@hushhealth.ai
3) NimbleMetrics LLC — admin@nimblemetrics.com

All three are active participants in Founders Batch 9; none are public companies. I re-attached the incubator acceptance email for BrightLayer (they were accepted on Oct 20).

We'd like a 60%/40% split: 60% of the requested credits available immediately, 40% released after demo week review (standard for our cohort). If Redwood requires a purchase order or signed MSA amendment for larger pools, please advise.

Appreciate the expedited review — if you can provision provisional claim links this week it would help the teams onboard to the SDKs.

Anna

Attachment stubs: BrightLayer_acceptance.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 14:48:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: SeedSpark cohort credit allocation (Founders Batch 9)

Forwarding Sofia's thread below — product ops has reviewed the docs and approves a provisional credit allocation for the three companies listed. Notes below for operations and billing: 

- Provisional allocation: 3 x $4,000 USD credit packages (apply immediate 60% = $2,400 usable now; remaining $1,600 pending demo week review).
- Create three self-serve claim tokens scoped to the company admin emails Anna provided; tokens expire 21 days after issuance.
- Flag the accounts for a demo-week quality check; if the outputs are clearly in production-grade use we release the remaining 40%.

Monica — can you confirm billing recording and whether we need a PO or any paperwork for this seed/sponsor bulk grant? If not, please confirm and I'll trigger claim link generation.

Sofia — once Monica confirms, I'll publish the claim links and send a short claim instructions email for each team.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Product Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SeedSpark cohort access pass verification & self-serve claim

Hi Anna — good news: we've provisioned provisional credit bundles for the three startups. Below are the one-time claim links and simple next steps. Note that each link is scoped to the admin email provided and expires in 21 days (claim deadline: 2026-11-30).

Claim links (one-time use):
- BrightLayer Inc. — https://redwood.app/portal/credits/claim/SPK-2026-2389-BL (admin: ceo@brightlayer.ai)
- HushHealth Ltd — https://redwood.app/portal/credits/claim/SPK-2026-2389-HH (admin: hello@hushhealth.ai)
- NimbleMetrics LLC — https://redwood.app/portal/credits/claim/SPK-2026-2389-NM (admin: admin@nimblemetrics.com)

What to expect after claiming:
- 60% of the credit package becomes active immediately.
- Teams can onboard to the SDK and run up to pre-configured quotas; we instrument usage and will run a demo-week review to determine release of remaining 40%.
- If you prefer a PO or an MSA amendment for accounting records, Monica is copied and can advise.

Attached: claim_instructions.pdf (short step-by-step for the teams).

If anything changes on your side (admin emails, company list), let me know and we'll reissue tokens. Otherwise, please share the claim links with the three admins and confirm after they've claimed so we can mark the pending credits for the demo-week review.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
